claims.claim_text: The indexed Kingman M Dong Sr. has a high-confidence match to artist Dong Kingman, an OSS cartographer.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army bulk entry agrees with the index on the full indexed name and a nonshared protected identifier. NARA and MOCA independently describe Dong Kingman's wartime OSS map work and explain the family-name order.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the unique protected identifier plus exact indexed Army name and independent institutional biographies with OSS cartographic context; Box 193 remains unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional biographies document wartime OSS service; they do not date the index person's recruitment or prove the immediately previous assignment.
claims.match_notes: Do not replace the index spelling or invert it silently. The article's account of Chinese naming conventions explains the alternate public name. Full service identifier withheld.

claims.claim_text: Dong Kingman worked for the Works Progress Administration as a painter before his documented OSS service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA explicitly says Kingman worked for the WPA before later serving in the OSS mapmaking division. MOCA dates WPA support to 1936-1941 and independently records OSS cartographic service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The indexed Kingman M Dong Sr. is linked to the Army bulk entry by exact full name and a nonshared protected identifier; NARA and MOCA document the distinctive artist's OSS work.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented earlier WPA employment. Neither source proves this was his immediate pre-OSS assignment or last civilian employer before Army service.
claims.match_notes: Count as an earlier documented employer only. Do not place WPA in immediate-predecessor or last-civilian-before-service aggregates.

sources.excerpt_override: Kingman worked for the Depression era Works Progress Administration applying his skills in art as a painter

claims.claim_text: A May 1945 Clark University alumni publication identifies Jocelyn Donaldson in the OSS Topographic Models Section and calls her a 1942-43 Clark student.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The contemporary alumni issue prints the exact indexed name, an OSS section and Washington location. It identifies earlier Clark student status but not a paid employer or the OSS entry date.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: distinctive exact name plus a specific OSS assignment in a contemporary institutional publication; the index row has no serial or rank to provide an independent protected-identifier cross-check.
claims.temporal_assessment: Student years 1942-43 precede the May 1945 publication's OSS observation, but their relationship to the actual OSS entry date remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: Clark student status is not a Clark employment claim, and it is not marked as the immediate pre-OSS affiliation. Inspect Box 192 for the transition date.

claims.claim_text: An Army bulk entry shares the indexed Ivan H Doman protected identifier but gives a different full name; this is an unresolved identity conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The printed index and official Army bulk record agree on a protected identifier but disagree completely on the person's name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting official identifiers and names; no Army biography or employer is assigned to the indexed person before Box 192 review.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry gives no reliable pre-OSS employer for the indexed Ivan H Doman.
claims.match_notes: Possible transcription, reassignment or source-data error; do not choose an explanation without the original personnel file. Full identifier withheld.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The NARA index and official Army bulk record ordinal 8361135 agree on exact full name and a nonshared protected identifier. NARA and MOCA independently identify Dong Kingman as an OSS mapmaker. WPA employment is documented earlier, not immediate before OSS.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 193 for Army-to-OSS transfer, last civilian employer before service, and exact WPA employment dates; do not infer an immediate WPA-to-OSS transfer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The May 1945 Clark University Geographical Society magazine prints the exact indexed name and specifically places Jocelyn Donaldson in the OSS Topographic Models Section. It records Clark student status in 1942-43 but neither employment nor OSS entry date.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 192 for actual OSS entry date, preceding employment or assignment, and whether Clark study had already ended; do not count student status as employment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The official Army bulk entry at ordinal 4930984 matches the printed protected identifier but gives a different full name. No biography or employer is transferred across this conflict.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Ivan H Doman's Box 192 file and original Army record to resolve the protected-identifier/name conflict before linking employment.
